(329)༄༅/ /su kha ma siddhi phyag rgya chen po'i ngo sprod bzhugs so/ /na mo/mkha' 'gro rig pa'i ngo sprod ni/ /nam mkha' ris med stong pa la/ /ra

tei:div.tei:p: su kha ma siddhi phyag rgya chen po'i ngo sprod bzhugs so/ /na mo/ mkha' 'gro rig pa'i ngo sprod ni// nam mkha' ris med stong pa la// rig bcas sems kyi rtsa ba gcun// rtsa ba gcun nas rang sor zhog /bskyed rim bzlas pa rdzogs pa dang*// g.yon pa'i khu tshur snying gar bzhag /g.yas pa'i khu tshur mdzub sgreng phyar// rdzi dang nyi mas mi gnod pa'i// nam mkha'i dkyil du gcer gyis blta// rig pa ngar btags dbang po bzlog /shes pa hur thon lus cha sgrim// rlung yang cung zad bzung byas la// rang gi lte bar a gcig bsgom// dbu ma nas brgyud tshang sgo nas// nam mkhar 'phur te yal ba dang*// chos nyid spros dang bral ba dang*// sems nyid spros dang bral ba dang*// spros bral nam mkha'i ngang nyid du// ma bcos so ma nyid du zhog /rtog pa'i rkyen gyis ma bslad par// phaṭa kyis rig pa mnan nas bskul// so ma so ma nyid du bzhag /rtog pa'i rkyen gyis g.yengs pa dang*// btang snyoms le los grol ba med// tha mal shes pa rang lugs 'di// ma bcos ngang du klod pa la// bsgom par bya ba ci yang med// sgom 'dod blo de skyur la thong*// kho rang rang gi gshis la zhog /rjes shes snang grags chos rnams kun// rmi lam sgyu mar rtogs par bya// gang la zhen med sems can don// rig pa mnyam med ngang la zhog /mkha' 'gro ma yi snying gtam yin// yang na bde ba bsdus rjes la// tha mal shes pa rang dag ni// sgom 'dod rtog pas ma bslad par// ma bcos ngang du klod la zhog/ cir yang mi dmigs de kho na// phyag rgya chen po zhes su brjod// // /gu ru ḍā ki na mo/ snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa 'di la gsum ste// dang po bzhag thabs rnam pa lngas dngul dkar gyi me long la bltas pas/ byang kyi dkyil (330)'khor mthong ba bzhin// mkha' 'gro rang sems gnyis phyag rgya chen por ngo sprod pa ni// lus kyi 'khrul 'khor ldan pa yis// nam mkha' ris med stong pa la// rig bcas sems kyi rtsa ba gcun// rtsa ba gcun la lhug par zhog

/rten med du zhog /'dzin med du zhog /'jog mkhan med par zhog /gnyis pa nyams su blangs thabs bcus lam du khyer ba ni/ mi phod pa brdzi/ 'khri ba bcad/ zhen pa zlog /snang ba bsgyur/ spyod pa dkrug /mtshang yul nas 'don/ rkyen dngos grub tu shes par bya// sdug bsngal chos nyid du shes par bya// rig pa khrog phyung*/ snyan brgyud mi la ma spel/ gsum pa thag chod lngas rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin bskyel pa ni/ sems stong bar thag bcad/ stong pa chos skur thag bcad/ chos sku la rgyun chad med par thag bcad/ re dogs med par thag bcad/ 'khor 'das med par thag bcad// su kha siddhi snyan brgyud gcig brgyud las med do// rdzogs so// sangs rgyas gnyan ston gyi zhal nas/ snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa kha ru mi 'don/ ngo dgar mi btang*// nor du mi tshong*// ched du mi bzhag /snod dang ldan pa la mi sba bar byin gsungs so// su kha ma siddhi phyag rgya chen po'i ngo sprod// zab mo gser gyi chos gus pas zhu bar bya'o// rdzogs so/// /
